attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners (Occupational Therapy Advisory Committee)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by AOTA (incl. AOTA-approved providers), LOTA or NBCOT, or pre-approved by the Board; Level II fieldwork education (1 h per 3-week period, max 4 h per year); presenting approved courses (2x participant credit); post-professional OTD/PhD or OTA bridge coursework (2 contact hours per credit hour, no credit for D/F).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license by examination held less than one year: exempt, provided the Laws & Rules course is completed before the first annual renewal.
rules.audit_note: CE must be documented in the Board's electronic CE tracking system and verified by the Board's contractor before the license can be renewed.

rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, Pt. XLV, §§1947, 1963–1979 (amended LR 51:652, May 2025); R.S. 37:3012
rules.notes: Annual renewal; license may be renewed from 8 weeks before the last day of the birth month. 1 CEU = 10 contact hours. The May 2025 amendment raised the requirement from 12 to 14 contact hours and added the ethics and LSBME rules courses. CE finished within 60 days after expiry allows late renewal with fees. Waivers for disability, illness, financial hardship on written request.
